newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE TO LAUNCH INDEX SOON, GIVES COMPOSITION.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE TO LAUNCH INDEX SOON, GIVES COMPOSITION.

text.p: Latvian bourse president Uldis Cerps said on Wednesday that the stock exchange would launch its own index soon and that it would include nine companies.

He told a news conference that the index would include all three official list shares Unibanka, Riga Transport Fleet and Staburadze plus Kaija, Valmiera Glassfibre, Daugavpils Chain, Rigas Raugs, Salacgriva and Lode Brick from the secondary list.
The index was due to be launched today but was delayed due to reasons.
Cerps said that there would be two indices, one in lats and another in dollars.
Cerps said the index would be calculated from April 2 last year and it has been given a base value of 100 on that date.
"Today the index would have been around 450," he said.
The index is calculated according to the capitalisation weight and will be calculated every day at the start.
Later, as trading becomes continuous, it will be calculated on a minute-by-minute basis, he added.
The composition of the index will be reviewed every quarter.
The index will represent 80 percent of the sectors quoted on the bourse, including cyclical, non-cyclical, financial and industrial companies.
He said that the credit rating Latvia received earlier this year helped increase interest to Latvian shares and boosted share prices by 40 to 60 million lats.
